o: If I were you, I would accept it, as long as the contract is permanent. Providing that the company is serious, it's a great opportunity.
But if I moved, I would miss my friends. Suppose you stayed here, would you be happier? Probably not, because I'm bored in my current job.
Another conversation, about a car. Can I borrow your car this weekend? Yes, you can, as long as you fill the tank before you return it.
say: If I were you, I would accept it, as long as the contract is permanent. Providing that the company is serious, it's a great opportunity.

p: ¿Qué significa «If you don't eat breakfast, you feel hungry all morning.»?
o: A menos que deje de llover, no podremos salir.
Si no desayunas, tienes hambre toda la mañana.
Si mezclas azul y amarillo, obtienes verde.
say: If you don't eat breakfast, you feel hungry all morning.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Si fuera más alto, jugaría al baloncesto profesionalmente.»?
o: If I were taller, I would play basketball professionally.
Suppose you could meet any famous person, who would it be?
If you don't eat breakfast, you feel hungry all morning.
say: If I were taller, I would play basketball professionally.

p: ¿Qué significa «And the fourth is suppose, or supposing, which we use to imagine a situation. Suppose you lost your job, what would you do?»?
o: Yo en tu lugar lo aceptaría, siempre que el contrato sea indefinido. Siempre que la empresa sea seria, es una gran oportunidad.
Y la cuarta es suppose, o supposing, que usamos para imaginar una situación. Supón que perdieras tu trabajo, ¿qué harías?
Si me tocara la lotería, compraría una casa junto al mar. Probablemente no me tocará, así que es una situación improbable.
say: And the fourth is suppose, or supposing, which we use to imagine a situation. Suppose you lost your job, what would you do?

p: ¿Qué significa «In the zero conditional, we can replace if with when, because the result is always the same. When it rains, the streets get wet.»?
o: Entonces ya tienes tu respuesta. A menos que encuentres algo mejor aquí, deberías irte. Y si no te gusta, siempre puedes volver.
En el condicional cero podemos sustituir if por when, porque el resultado es siempre el mismo. Cuando llueve, las calles se mojan.
¿Por qué? Porque me encanta la naturaleza y la gente es amable. Pero no me iría a menos que mi familia viniera conmigo. ¿Y tú?
say: In the zero conditional, we can replace if with when, because the result is always the same. When it rains, the streets get wet.

p: ¿Qué significa «Now the second conditional. It's for unreal or very unlikely situations in the present or the future. If, plus past simple, and would plus the verb.»?
o: Ahora el segundo condicional. Es para situaciones irreales o muy improbables en el presente o el futuro. If, más pasado simple, y would más el verbo.
Otra conversación, sobre un coche. ¿Puedo coger tu coche este fin de semana? Sí, puedes, siempre que llenes el depósito antes de devolverlo.
Pero si me mudara, echaría de menos a mis amigos. Supón que te quedaras aquí, ¿serías más feliz? Probablemente no, porque estoy aburrido en mi trabajo actual.
say: Now the second conditional. It's for unreal or very unlikely situations in the present or the future. If, plus past simple, and would plus the verb.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «A menos que deje de llover, no podremos salir.»?
o: I won't tell anyone unless you give me permission.
If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
Unless it stops raining, we won't be able to go out.
say: Unless it stops raining, we won't be able to go out.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Si no desayunas, tienes hambre toda la mañana.»?
o: If I won a million euros, I would travel around the world.
If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll have a picnic in the park.
If you don't eat breakfast, you feel hungry all morning.
say: If you don't eat breakfast, you feel hungry all morning.

p: Completa: If I were you, I would accept it, as long as the contract is permanent. _____ that the company is serious, it's a great opportunity.
h: Significa: Yo en tu lugar lo aceptaría, siempre que el contrato sea indefinido. Siempre que la empresa sea seria, es una gran oportunidad.
o: Morning
Raining
Providing
say: If I were you, I would accept it, as long as the contract is permanent. Providing that the company is serious, it's a great opportunity.

p: Completa: If I had more time, I would learn to _____ the guitar.
h: Significa: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería a tocar la guitarra.
o: result
sunny
play
say: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «No te dé vergüenza. Hablar en voz alta es la mejor forma de mejorar tu pronunciación.»?
o: Second, first conditional: if plus present, will. For real future possibilities.
Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to improve your pronunciation.
Third, second conditional: if plus past, would. For unreal or unlikely situations.
say: Don't be shy. Speaking out loud is the best way to improve your pronunciation.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Siempre que haga buen tiempo, el partido empezará a las seis.»?
o: If I won a million euros, I would travel around the world.
Provided that the weather is good, the match will start at six.
Before the mistakes, one more conversation, about a job offer.
say: Provided that the weather is good, the match will start at six.

p: ¿Qué significa «Before the mistakes, one more conversation, about a job offer.»?
o: No te dé vergüenza. Hablar en voz alta es la mejor forma de mejorar tu pronunciación.
Primero, condicional cero: if más presente, presente. Para hechos y hábitos.
Antes de los errores, una conversación más, sobre una oferta de trabajo.
say: Before the mistakes, one more conversation, about a job offer.

p: ¿Cómo se dice «Si mezclas azul y amarillo, obtienes verde.»?
o: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
If she studies hard, she'll get a good mark.
What would you do if you saw a ghost?
say: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
